name: Off-Hand Power Layup
setup: Start a few steps out from the basket, ball in both hands.
cues: Same drill with the ball in your less-used hand: slow and clean beats fast and messy.
Jump stop, then go up off both feet, the ball held high and strong.
High knee up toward the target on the take-off.

faults.fault: Taking off too far under the basket
faults.fix: Leave the floor a step earlier so you rise up to the target.
Carry the ball high, chin to forehead, away from the reach.
